description: An off-by-one in a pagination helper drops the last item of every page.
prompt: The tests in src/pagination.test.ts are failing. Find and fix the bug in this repository so that every test passes. Do not change the tests.

mustPass: a full page contains every item in the page
the second page starts where the first ended
a trailing partial page returns only what is left
every item appears exactly once across all pages

notes: pageSlice computes its end index as start + size - 1, so each page is one item short. The visible test only covers the first page; the withheld tests cover later pages, the trailing partial page and the out-of-range page, so a fix that special-cases page zero does not pass.
